name: ESP32-DevKitC V4

outline.source: ESP32-DevKitC V4 user guide and dimensions drawing (Espressif): 54.4 x 27.9 mm overall (with the PCB antenna); not yet checked against the DXF, corners treated as square

pcb.source: typical FR4 board thickness; not dimensioned in the guide

mounting_holes.source: ASSUMED support points: the ESP32-DevKitC has NO mounting holes; these two positions on the centre line between the header rows are suggested spots for printed support posts (M2 self-tapping), not holes in the board

connectors.name: micro-USB
connectors.source: micro-B receptacle centred on the short edge (y = 13.95 mm), overhanging by about 1.3 mm
connectors.note: size and overhang approximate; the height 3.1 mm also covers the ESP32-WROOM-32 module top

omitted: ESP32-WROOM-32 module (about 3.1 mm above the PCB, covered by the micro-USB box height) and the PCB antenna end
EN and BOOT buttons (about 3.5 mm tall at the USB end; no opening unless the user needs button access)
pin headers (2 x 19, 2.54 mm pitch, 25.4 mm apart; the pin tails protrude below the PCB)
